title: Executive Director of Strategic Communications
description:
Position Overview

The Executive Director of Strategic Communications is responsible
for providing leadership, oversight, and direction for a
University-wide strategic communications strategy for the primary
purpose of elevating the University’s national reputation and
awareness.

Reporting directly to the Vice President for University Advancement
and Marketing, the Executive Director will lead a cross-functional
team from across the University charged with elevating Butler’s
national reputation and awareness by aligning external and internal
communications, executive positioning, public relations and media
relations, and University partnerships.

Specifically, this position will lead:

The creation and execution of a University-wide external
communications plan
the curation of high-impact stories to be told by leadership
through national and local forums, speeches, and thought leadership
pieces
national and local media interactions
crisis communications/issue management, and serve as the
University spokesperson

Additionally, the Executive Director will oversee the University’s
live mascot program as a key asset in building national awareness.
The live mascot handler will report directly to this
position.

The ideal candidate will have experience and skills in these areas:
institutional communications, public relations, media relations,
and issues management/crisis communications. The candidate will be
exceptional in strategy development and implementation, leading in
a cross functional environment, and internal relationship building.
Excellent writing skills are required.

Applicants must submit a cover letter to be considered for
this position

Responsibilities

Lead the University’s strategic communications effort, in
collaboration with key campus partners, for the purpose of
elevating the University’s national reputation and awareness.
Develop a University-wide strategic communications plan and
execute that plan by leading a cross-functional strategic
communications team.
Work closely with University leadership to develop and execute
an executive positioning strategy
Manage media relations efforts, and serve as the University’s
spokesperson.
Lead the Crisis Communications Team and collaborate with the
Crisis Management and Emergency Operations Teams.
Oversee the University’s live mascot program
Develop methods to measure and analyze results toward advancing
key University priorities and optimizing ongoing efforts.
Participate in the University Marketing Council, along with
other relevant work groups and committees.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, or related
field; master’s degree or equivalent work experience
preferred.

10+ years of strategic communications or similar
experience.

Strong foundation in communications and marketing competencies,
including corporate communications, media relations, and strategic
communications planning. Connections with the media, and experience
with pitches and editorial process preferred.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to
change voice and writing style to fit a particular audience and
purpose.

Demonstrated ability to prioritize and meet multiple deadlines
and handle a variety of tasks simultaneously. Must be able to
simultaneously work effectively at the highest level on strategy,
and execute the smallest details.

Strong organizational and project management skills with the
ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.


Preferred Qualifications

Prior higher education communications experience.

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
